title: Run portfolio
description: The final output manifest of a run: at most max_survivors structurally non-redundant survivors (default 3, configurable up to 6 via init_run.py --max-survivors). check_portfolio.py audits this file together with the survivor candidate files.

domain.description: The search brief's domain or problem area.

breadth.description: Declared in Phase 0; wide means a substantially wider candidate funnel with a collision-search quota (facets.md), not a looser bar.

max_survivors.description: Per-run ceiling declared via init_run.py --max-survivors (default 3). A ceiling is a permission, not a quota — padding survivors to reach it is the exact failure mode the ceiling exists to prevent.

survivors.description: Zero survivors is an acceptable, honest outcome. Near-clones up to max_survivors is not.
